_comment: Execution accuracy, not SQL similarity: each case carries a reference query whose result is the ground truth, and a run passes when the pipeline's rows carry the same values. Reference queries select only the values that discriminate a right answer from a wrong one — a label column appears only where its identity matters and its spelling is stable, so a run is never failed for choosing name_ar over name_en or for formatting a month differently. Expressing truth as SQL rather than as literals keeps the set valid when the synthetic dataset is regenerated.

_match_modes.scalar: one row, one meaningful value; the run must also return exactly one row
_match_modes.set: same number of rows, matched in any order
_match_modes.ordered: same number of rows, matched position by position (rankings, time series)

_tolerance: relative, applied to numeric comparisons; 0.01 unless a case overrides it

cases.question: What was the total transaction value in 2025?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(price_aed) FROM transactions WHERE transaction_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND transaction_date < DATE '2026-01-01'

cases.question: How many property transactions were registered in 2025?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transactions WHERE transaction_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND transaction_date < DATE '2026-01-01'

cases.question: Which 5 communities had the highest total transaction value in 2025?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT c.name_en, SUM(t.price_aed) FROM transactions t JOIN communities c ON c.id = t.community_id WHERE t.transaction_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND t.transaction_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY c.name_en ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5

cases.question: What was the average transaction price on Yas Island in 2025?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT AVG(t.price_aed) FROM transactions t JOIN communities c ON c.id = t.community_id WHERE c.name_en = 'Yas Island' AND t.transaction_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND t.transaction_date < DATE '2026-01-01'

cases.question: What is the average annual rent for a 2 bedroom apartment on Al Reem Island?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(r.total_annual_rent_aed) / NULLIF(SUM(r.leased_units), 0) FROM rental_market_stats r JOIN communities c ON c.id = r.community_id JOIN property_types p ON p.id = r.property_type_id JOIN layouts l ON l.id = r.layout_id WHERE c.name_en = 'Al Reem Island' AND p.name = 'Apartment' AND l.bedrooms = 2

cases.question: What was the total mortgage value by lender type in 2025?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT lender_type, SUM(mortgage_value_aed) FROM mortgages WHERE mortgage_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND mortgage_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY lender_type

cases.question: What was the total off-plan transaction value in 2025?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(price_aed) FROM transactions WHERE is_offplan AND transaction_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND transaction_date < DATE '2026-01-01'

cases.question: What is the most recent villa sale price index value?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT pi.index_value FROM price_indices pi JOIN property_types pt ON pt.id = pi.property_type_id WHERE pt.name = 'Villa' AND pi.index_type = 'sale' ORDER BY pi.month DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: What is the most recent apartment rent index value?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT pi.index_value FROM price_indices pi JOIN property_types pt ON pt.id = pi.property_type_id WHERE pt.name = 'Apartment' AND pi.index_type = 'rent' ORDER BY pi.month DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: What was the average number of leased residential units per quarter in 2025?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT AVG(period_total) FROM (SELECT period_end, SUM(leased_units) AS period_total FROM rental_market_stats WHERE period_end >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND period_end < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY period_end) sub

cases.question: Which 3 districts had the highest total transaction value in 2025?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT d.name_en, SUM(t.price_aed) FROM transactions t JOIN communities c ON c.id = t.community_id JOIN districts d ON d.id = c.district_id WHERE t.transaction_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND t.transaction_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY d.name_en ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 3

cases.question: What was the average price per square metre on Saadiyat Island in 2025?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT AVG(t.rate_aed_sqm) FROM transactions t JOIN communities c ON c.id = t.community_id WHERE c.name_en = 'Saadiyat Island' AND t.transaction_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND t.transaction_date < DATE '2026-01-01'

cases.question: How many brokers are registered?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM brokers

cases.question: Which 5 developers have the most projects?
cases.note: set rather than ordered: the top five contains a 19/19 and a 15/15 tie, so the order within them is arbitrary.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT d.name, COUNT(p.id) FROM developers d JOIN projects p ON p.developer_id = d.id GROUP BY d.name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5

cases.question: Show the monthly transaction value for Yas Island in 2025
cases.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(t.price_aed) FROM transactions t JOIN communities c ON c.id = t.community_id WHERE c.name_en = 'Yas Island' AND t.transaction_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND t.transaction_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY date_trunc('month', t.transaction_date) ORDER BY date_trunc('month', t.transaction_date)

cases.question: What was the total transaction value by property type in 2025?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT pt.name, SUM(t.price_aed) FROM transactions t JOIN property_types pt ON pt.id = t.property_type_id WHERE t.transaction_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND t.transaction_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY pt.name

cases.question: What was the total transaction value in Al Ain City in 2025?
cases.note: resolves a place at the municipality level rather than the community level.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(t.price_aed) FROM transactions t JOIN communities c ON c.id = t.community_id JOIN districts d ON d.id = c.district_id JOIN municipalities m ON m.id = d.municipality_id WHERE m.name_en = 'Al Ain City' AND t.transaction_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND t.transaction_date < DATE '2026-01-01'

cases.question: What was the total transaction value in Khalifa City in 2025?
cases.note: uses a prefix match on 'Khalifa City' rather than equality, defensively — an exact community name mismatch elsewhere would otherwise silently return nothing.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(t.price_aed) FROM transactions t JOIN communities c ON c.id = t.community_id WHERE c.name_en LIKE 'Khalifa City%' AND t.transaction_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND t.transaction_date < DATE '2026-01-01'

cases.question: What share of 2025 transaction value came from the secondary market?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN market_type = 'secondary' THEN price_aed ELSE 0 END) / SUM(price_aed) FROM transactions WHERE transaction_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND transaction_date < DATE '2026-01-01'

cases.question: ما هو إجمالي قيمة المعاملات العقارية في عام 2025؟
cases.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(price_aed) FROM transactions WHERE transaction_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND transaction_date < DATE '2026-01-01'

cases.question: كم عدد المعاملات العقارية المسجلة في عام 2025؟
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transactions WHERE transaction_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND transaction_date < DATE '2026-01-01'

cases.question: ما هي أعلى خمس مناطق من حيث إجمالي قيمة المبيعات في عام 2025؟
cases.note: values only — the run may label the ranking with either name column.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(t.price_aed) FROM transactions t JOIN communities c ON c.id = t.community_id WHERE t.transaction_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND t.transaction_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 5

cases.question: ما هو متوسط الإيجار السنوي للشقق في جزيرة الريم؟
cases.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(r.total_annual_rent_aed) / NULLIF(SUM(r.leased_units), 0) FROM rental_market_stats r JOIN communities c ON c.id = r.community_id JOIN property_types p ON p.id = r.property_type_id WHERE c.name_en = 'Al Reem Island' AND p.name = 'Apartment'

cases.question: ما هي آخر قيمة لمؤشر أسعار بيع الفلل؟
cases.reference_sql: SELECT pi.index_value FROM price_indices pi JOIN property_types pt ON pt.id = pi.property_type_id WHERE pt.name = 'Villa' AND pi.index_type = 'sale' ORDER BY pi.month DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: ما هو إجمالي قيمة الرهون العقارية في عام 2025؟
cases.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(mortgage_value_aed) FROM mortgages WHERE mortgage_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND mortgage_date < DATE '2026-01-01'

cases.question: كم عدد الوحدات السكنية المؤجرة في جزيرة ياس؟
cases.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(r.leased_units) FROM rental_market_stats r JOIN communities c ON c.id = r.community_id WHERE c.name_en = 'Yas Island' AND r.period_end = (SELECT MAX(period_end) FROM rental_market_stats)

cases.question: ما هو إجمالي قيمة المبيعات في مدينة خليفة خلال عام 2025؟
cases.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(t.price_aed) FROM transactions t JOIN communities c ON c.id = t.community_id WHERE c.name_en LIKE 'Khalifa City%' AND t.transaction_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND t.transaction_date < DATE '2026-01-01'

cases.question: ما هو متوسط سعر المتر المربع في جزيرة السعديات خلال عام 2025؟
cases.reference_sql: SELECT AVG(t.rate_aed_sqm) FROM transactions t JOIN communities c ON c.id = t.community_id WHERE c.name_en = 'Saadiyat Island' AND t.transaction_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND t.transaction_date < DATE '2026-01-01'

cases.question: ما هي نسبة قيمة معاملات السوق الثانوي في عام 2025؟
cases.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN market_type = 'secondary' THEN price_aed ELSE 0 END) / SUM(price_aed) FROM transactions WHERE transaction_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND transaction_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
